name: VoltScope
subtitle: Battery telemetry for iPhone and compatible Bluetooth accessories
description: Unsigned native iOS builds. Sign using FlareStore or EmberSign. Privileged hardware readings are best-effort on jailbroken iPhones.

apps.name: VoltScope
apps.subtitle: Battery diagnostics and connected-device monitoring
apps.localizedDescription: Charging current and voltage where device permissions allow, battery history and drain analysis, Bluetooth batteries, FindMyBLE LARQ bottle cache, and widgets.

versions.localizedDescription: FindMyBLE LARQ/Find My battery handoff, graceful missing App Group fallback, device-specific battery ring widgets and charging diagnostics.
versions.changelog: LARQ and supported Apple device batteries via updated FindMyBLE. Ring widgets now show proper phone, watch, AirPods, case and bottle symbols. Three-part versioning for FlareStore.
